name: get_flight_status
description: Get live status of any flight at Delhi Airport (DEL) for a date: scheduled and estimated time, status (on-time, delayed, cancelled), terminal, gate for departures and baggage belt for arrivals. Public information; no sign-in needed.

flightNo.description: Airline code plus number without spaces, uppercase, e.g. 6E2134, AI101, QP1334

date.description: Flight date as YYYY-MM-DD (local IST), e.g. 2026-10-23

name: get_booking
description: Get the signed-in passenger's own flight booking by PNR: flight, date, route, seat, booking status, web check-in and terminal.

name: get_baggage_claim
description: Get the signed-in passenger's delayed or damaged baggage report (PIR) by reference: status, where the bag was last seen and the next step.

pirRef.description: Property Irregularity Report reference: station + airline code + 5 digits, uppercase, e.g. DELEK48213

name: search_lost_found
description: Search the signed-in passenger's lost property reports at Delhi Airport by item type: where it was found, claim status, where to collect and how long it is kept.

item.description: Item type in lowercase, one of the listed values

date.description: Optional date the item was lost (YYYY-MM-DD), used only to mention it in the answer

name: get_parking_booking
description: Get the signed-in customer's Park & Fly parking booking by reference: terminal, zone, slot, check-in and check-out times, amount paid, status and cancellation deadline.

ref.description: Park & Fly booking reference, e.g. PNF-T3-260471
